designs.gfx: black five‑point star at upper left; small black silhouette (outline) of the state of Texas used centrally between serial groups; thin black keyline border around plate

designs.cap: A scenic Texas passenger plate: pale blue sky over stylized purple-brown mountains with a single white star and a red-and-blue brushstroke at the top left. The small Texas silhouette with the Texas flag appears between the character groups and "TEXAS" heads the plate with "The Lone Star State" along the bottom.
designs.base: pale blue sky gradient from darker at top to lighter toward center, with a horizontal band of stylized mountains and plains across the lower third
designs.gfx: white five-point star with red-and-blue brushstroke behind it at top-left; small silhouette of the state of Texas with inset Texas-flag motif centered between the serial groups; stylized row of purple-brown mountains/hills across lower third; pale blue sky with white clouds; thin keyline border

designs.cap: A plain white Utah plate with bold black raised characters and a small triangular emblem between the groups. Very minimal design: white field, narrow keyline, the word UTAH centerd along the bottom and an embossed pyramid/triangle device above the bottom legend.

designs.gfx: small raised triangular/pyramid emblem centered between the two serial groups, with a short raised horizontal bar immediately beneath the triangle; narrow raised keyline/band around the plate edge

designs.cap: A plain, vintage cream-colored Utah plate with tall, narrow black characters and a thin raised border. The only fixed legend is UTAH 73 along the bottom; the registration characters are embossed in a narrow sans style.

designs.cap: A celebratory Utah centennial design with a large orange sandstone arch set against pale mountains and a blue sky. The words UTAH sit at the top and CENTENNIAL with the years 1896 and 1996 run along the bottom.

designs.ink: dark navy (very dark blue, almost black)

designs.cap: A patriotic Utah passenger plate on a white field, dominated by a waving American flag at left and bold civic mottos. Distinguishing details are the red cursive "Utah" at top, the stacked blue legend "In GOD We TRUST" under the flag, and the red all-caps motto "UNITED WE STAND" along the bottom.
designs.base: white reflective background with a subtle metallic/speckled finish
designs.gfx: upper-left: a waving American flag (blue canton with white stars, red and white stripes); below the flag, stacked text reading "In GOD We TRUST" in blue; upper-right: two small printed boxes labeled "Mo." and "Yr." for stickers

designs.cap: A pale cream Utah specialty plate themed for skiing: bold dark-blue embossed characters on a light field with a small blue downhill skier graphic and the red slogan wordmark. Top reads "Ski Utah!" in stylized script/italic, bottom reads the slogan in all caps.
designs.base: pale cream / off-white flat background (slightly warm)
designs.gfx: small blue downhill skier figure above the left/center of the plate with curved ski tracks behind; stylized blue script word "Ski" near top center-left and red italic word "Utah!" top right (these are part of the top legend)

designs.cap: Plain, silver metallic background with tall, narrow black embossed characters and the single word UTAH centered along the bottom. Very minimalist — no scenery or symbols, just the raised characters and a rounded raised rim.

designs.cap: A plain, mid-century Utah plate: white background with bold black raised characters and a simple raised border. The only printed legend is the bottom caption "UTAH 73." and the design otherwise contains no pictorial art.

designs.cap: A very plain Utah plate: white field with glossy black raised characters and a narrow raised rim. The only printed legend is the small word UTAH centered at the bottom; otherwise the design is unadorned.

designs.cap: A colorful Utah souvenir design with a stylized Delicate Arch/rock formation centered over a striped desert horizon. designs.cap: A patriotic Utah design dominated by a waving American flag at left and bold red script UTah at top. Distinctive mottos — the stacked In GOD We TRUST at left and UNITED WE STAND centered at the bottom — and an embossed dark blue serial complete the design.
